title: FAQ
description: Can you study part-time for the Master in European Studies in Investor Relations and Financial Communication ? Do we offer distance-learning? Do you need a Visa? You find the answers to these questions and even more here.

blocks.html:
1. How many places are available?
    Up to 60 places are available for each intake.
  2. Can I access with any bachelor's degree?
    No, only specific academic backgrounds are accepted (Economics, Communication Sciences or other relevant disciplines, e.g., political sciences and law). Students must obtain the undergraduate degree before 31 December 2022.
    Details for students with a Bachelor's degree granted by an Italian university are available at: https://www.unicatt.it/content/dam/siti-web/unicatt/it/corsi/bancarie/25...
  3. Which degrees are automatically eligible?
    • ​​Bachelor's Degree in Communication or Bachelor's Degree in Economics granted at Università della Svizzera italiana
    • Bachelor’s Degree in Economia dei mercati e degli intermediari finanziari, Scienze linguistiche e Scienze linguistiche per le relazioni internazionali granted at Università Cattolica dal Sacro Cuore, with a minimum weighted average of 23/30 and at least 110 ECTS.
  4. Are there languages requirements?
    Yes, students must prove their English and Italian level through a certification. Exemptions can be made under certain conditions.
    https://www.usi.ch/en/education/master/investor-relations-financial-communication/admission
  5. Technical questions on admission procedure:
    • ​​Candidates with Bachelor's degree granted by an Italian university: https://www.unicatt.it/content/dam/siti-web/unicatt/it/corsi/bancarie/25...
    • Candidates with Bachelor's degree granted by any other university: https://international.unicatt.it/ucscinternational-admission-and-tuition-application-procedures-6579
  6. When can I apply?
    • ​​Candidates with Bachelor's degree granted by an Italian university: https://www.unicatt.it/content/dam/siti-web/unicatt/it/corsi/bancarie/25...
    • Candidates with Bachelor's degree granted by any other university: https://international.unicatt.it/ucscinternational-admission-and-tuition-application-timeline-6578
  7. Are there lodgings available?
    • ​​Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore: https://studenticattolica.unicatt.it/home-servizi-e-campus-life​​​​
    • Università della Svizzera italiana: https://www.desk.usi.ch/it/usi-home
  8. How do I get help for the internship?
    • ​​Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Stage & Placement: stage-mi@unicatt.it
    • Università della Svizzera italiana, Career Service: careerservice@usi.ch
      ​
  9. Where can I find the study plan?
    https://www.unicatt.it/corsi/european-studies-in-investor-relations-financial-communication-milano-22-23-curriculum#sep
